sentence: Made weak by time and fate, but strong in will / To strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield.

source.author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
source.detail: 诗作《尤利西斯》最后两行，年迈的奥德修斯决心再次出海远航

translation: 虽被时光与命运磨去了力气，意志却依然坚强——去奋斗，去探寻，去发现，永不屈服。
grammar: 这两行出自一个长句的结尾，完整骨架是 "...that which we are, we are; / One equal temper of heroic hearts, / Made weak by time and fate, but strong in will / To strive..."。这里的 Made weak... 和 strong in will... 都是修饰前面 heroic hearts 的后置成分，本身不是完整句子，没有自己的谓语。
Made weak by time and fate 是过去分词短语，表被动：(hearts that are) made weak by time and fate，“被时光和命运变得虚弱”。结构是 make + 宾语 + 形容词（make sb weak）的被动形式，by 引出动作的施加者。
but 连接两个并列成分：过去分词短语 made weak... 和形容词短语 strong in will...，形成“身体弱、意志强”的鲜明对比。strong in sth 表示“在某方面强”。
To strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield 是四个并列的不定式，作 will 的后置定语，说明是“做什么的意志”（will to do sth）。注意否定不定式的写法是 not to do，not 放在 to 前面。四个动词节奏层层推进，最后用否定收尾，力量感很强。

vocab.collocation: strive for sth / strive to do sth / strive against sth
vocab.example: We strive to keep the firmware small and reliable.

vocab.meaning: 屈服，让步（句中义）；也有“产出、产量”的意思
vocab.collocation: yield to pressure / yield results / a high yield
vocab.example: She refused to yield to pressure from her boss.

vocab.collocation: strong will / the will to do sth / against one's will / willpower
vocab.example: He has the will to finish what he starts.

vocab.collocation: by fate / a twist of fate / decide sb's fate / tempt fate
vocab.example: By a twist of fate, they met again ten years later.

vocab.collocation: seek advice / seek help / seek to do sth
vocab.example: If you're stuck, don't be afraid to seek help.

note: 小练习：模仿 "strong in will to strive" 的结构，用 "strong in + 名词 + to do" 写一句描述自己的话，比如 "Tired in body, but strong in will to finish this project." 另外记住：不定式的否定，规范写法是把 not 放在 to 前面，即 not to do。
